scope: Supplemental unpadded DistilGPT2 measurement on the eight original held-out capital prompts after successful standalone selection and numerical checks. This protocol evaluates a fixed intervention using the recovered NumPy GPT2Model without changing the release.
entry_gate: Require MEASURED, validated selection hash chain, all original numerical checks passing their original bounds, and exact seven-file checkpoint. Never select or change cases, controls, selection, or limits using validation.
selection: Consume exclusively the discovery-frozen layer, neuron, same-layer control IDs, selected signed vector, and six norm-matched random vectors in the original selection.json.
cases: All four validation_positive and all four validation_control prompts in protocol order, single unpadded sequence each. Re-tokenize every text; verify exact match with nonpadding IDs, position IDs, attention mask and target/foil encodings.
engines: Recovered read-only NumPy GPT2Model versus the locally reviewed HF GPT2LMHeadModel in float32 eager eval on CPU, one thread per library and no KV cache. Use each engine's own baseline tensors.
interventions: For selected and six fixed same-layer random neurons, zero the final-token post-GELU activation on HF and subtract a_j times its projection row from the final-token MLP output in NumPy. Compare each engine's complete logits, all positions and vocabulary. Add each of the seven discovery-frozen vectors separately to the final-token MLP output at each of six layers and compare complete logits and margins.
mechanism: Compare unhooked and instrumented HF baseline, selected projection-input activation and all layer MLP outputs, residual block inputs/outputs and attention output arrays across engines on baseline and selected ablation. On NumPy compare selected or control row subtraction with independent direct recomputation of zeroed projection before bias; the final-position row is the only changed token. Test NumPy no-op patch, Torch zero addition, and restored baseline for exact equality.
numerics_basis: Cross-engine tensor limits inherited from the recovered examples/pretrained-protocol.json reference_comparison. Both independent singlet runs are also compared with the original batched per-prompt margin effects (4e-3 is four times the inherited absolute logit ceiling for a difference of margins). No threshold changes after observing held-out results.
evidence: Per-case text/IDs, activations, target and foil margins, projection reconstructions, both engine array hashes, checks, maxima/locations and RMSE. Save paired raw baseline and selected full logits and key intermediates as compressed NPZ per prompt. Stream per-control and per-layer metrics to JSON for each prompt.
failure_policy: A failed source numerical gate suppresses this held-out comparison. A supplemental mismatch is retained as a negative finding and blocks a cross-engine parity claim. No tolerance or selection adjustments.
